layout.$description: Page layout spacing that changes by screen class: compact under 600px, medium 600 to 839px, expanded 840px and up (Material 3 window size classes). Rule: big spaces shrink to about two thirds on phones; small spacing inside components never changes.

gutter.$description: Space between the page edge and content.

section.$description: Space between major sections of a page.

title-gap.$description: Space under a page title, before the page's first content.
